review_scope: Full 22-line enablement article and one-line permission fragment read. Three navigation fragments already independently reviewed. Product labels, target availability and enforcement remain unresolved. No setting changed or paid feature enabled.

claims.statement: The enablement article describes blocking and bypass-alert generation as separate product behaviors; its introduction is not an observed behavior receipt.
The article declares fpt, ghes and ghec applicability; permission and product prerequisites still apply to the exact target.
The enablement procedure navigates to the repository, Settings and its version-conditioned security area via reusable fragments.
The procedure first enables Secret Protection if not already enabled; it does not waive approval for feature or cost changes.
The procedure separately enables Push protection within Secret Protection; prior feature enablement is not equivalent to this setting or observed blocking.
The permission fragment lists repository owners, organization owners, security managers and admin-role users; neither this list nor navigation access proves effective target authority.
